title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
马寻小看了古人的决心和速度，锦衣卫也好、朱元璋也罢，都是昼夜兼程。日常行军三十里左右普遍，那是普通的行军。但是一些急报等，日行百里就是保守速度了。他以为现在信使等可能才到应天府，可是谁知道朱元璋都已经探完底了。徐达、常遇春、李文忠三驾马车还在北伐，朱元璋书信一封，令沐英率军护卫皇后、太子前来宿州。本来就追封了马太公为徐王，也准备建庙立坟。现在马寻将马太公的遗骨送回来了，马秀英这个孝女自然要来。朱元璋是非常孝顺的人，他还没有登基的时候就让人在老家修建父母的陵墓，已经定下来了在家乡凤阳营建中都。马寻忧心忡忡、寝食难安，不过现在的他逃不掉，四周都是人呢。有着黑眼圈的马寻吃完早饭就来到院子里溜达，“旺财，你吃了没？”瘦驴很不给面子，它吃的可好了。精细的饲料、豆饼，还加了鸡蛋，一些良马都没有这样的饲料。仔细检查了食槽后，马寻也安心了，“我们哥俩现在虽然被人提防，但是不会亏待。真要是在劫难逃，起码是饱死鬼对不对？”勤快的朱元璋也走出房间，看到马寻就笑着打招呼，“小弟，这么早就起来了？”“溜达溜达。”马寻就说道，“只可惜不准我出去，只能在院里溜达了。”朱元璋笑着问道，“也去徐王府看看？”马寻立刻吐槽说道，“还徐王府呢，还没来得及看看宿州是什么样就给带过来软禁了，也就是每天准我去给老头的棺椁进香。”朱元璋笑着说道，“俺陪你去给先人进香，动身吧。”马寻给软禁在驿站，但是马老头的棺椁停放在徐王陵旁的庙里。现在马皇后没有来认亲，谁也不敢将老头的棺椁放进祭殿，也不敢随意将棺椁置之不理。马寻察觉到了不对，看着身边的护卫问道，“大哥，您的官挺大？”“俺以前是元帅。”朱元璋笑着说道，“算是这些人的头，他们归俺管。”明朝现在还没有大封功臣，而元帅府、元帅，就是卫所、卫指挥使。“失敬失敬！”马寻立刻觉得这是大人物了，“大哥，可否告知小弟名讳？”朱元璋一笑置之，他还是不告诉马寻姓名。到了小庙，马寻恭恭敬敬的上香。只是当他看到朱元璋也跪下磕头进香，顿时有些急了。等到朱元璋上完香，马寻还礼后说道，“大哥，你这么做有些不太好吧？”

朱元璋看向马寻问道，“哪里不好？徐王灵前只能你祭祀，我就不能祭祀？”马寻一时不知怎么反驳，只能说道，“还没认呢，你磕头磕早了。”朱元璋笑着问道，“徐王没给你留个玉佩之类的信物？如果有信物就好办了。”马寻更为郁闷了，“真要是有信物，我早拿出来了，哪能不明不白的在这里。”进完香，朱元璋说道，“和俺出去转转，看看宿州现在如何了。”马寻求之不得，他一直给软禁在驿站。现在能有人做主带他出去转转，肯定是好事情。马寻一边走一边问道，“大哥今年多大？”“四十二了，五子二女。”朱元璋看了一眼马寻说道，“还想试探俺什么？痛痛快快的说出来。”马寻虽然尴尬，不过连声说道，“大哥好福气，子女多有福气！”天下初定，宿州这片土地当年也是饱经战乱。刘福通和元军没少在这里大战，朱元璋夺下这里后也在持续恢复民生。尤其是刚刚进入初春，现在街上的人更少，百姓大部分也都是面有菜色、瘦骨嶙峋，想要吃饱何其难！马寻斟酌片刻后问道，“大哥，从应天府到这里，大概要几天？”朱元璋算了一下说道，“估计皇后他们五六天后能到。”马寻急了，更是忐忑，“真的是皇后亲自过来？”朱元璋被马寻的反应逗笑了，“事关徐王，自然是皇后亲来，难道你觉得该皇帝过来？”马寻觉得有道理，问道，“皇后仁慈，真要是有什么误会肯定也能饶了我。”朱元璋肯定的说道，“那可未必，如果是其他事情，皇后宽宏大量说不定能饶了你。但是事关徐王，那就不能有闪失。”随即朱元璋开玩笑说道，“皇后来了，你就要成徐王了！”马寻愣了一下，随即也反应过来，“就算皇后认了我，徐王又和我有什么关系？”朱元璋认真分析说道，“先徐王只有一女一子，你既然是徐王之子，那徐王王爵自然是落在你身上。”“开玩笑呢！”马寻立刻摇头，“我没有功劳，就因为是皇后的弟弟就能成徐王？异姓，我到底是异姓，岂能为王！”朱元璋顿时高看一眼马寻，追封马太公为徐王是应该的。不过那也是因为马太公没有子嗣，这才追封徐王。郭子兴现在还没有被追封为滁阳王呢！朱元璋就继续说道，“就算不能为王，怎么也得是国公。”马寻摇头说道，“皇帝还没有大封功臣，满朝文武里有大功的人多呢。封我个爵位肯定说不过去，那以后大明爵位就乱了，封爵禄外戚之家，你觉得好吗？”
content_en:
Ma Xun underestimated the determination and speed of the ancients, whether Jin Yiwei or Zhu Yuanzhang, they all traveled day and night.A daily march of about thirty miles is common, and that is an ordinary march.But for some urgent reports, traveling a hundred miles a day is a conservative speed.He thought that the messenger might arrive at Yingtian Mansion now, but who knew that Zhu Yuanzhang had already explored the bottom.The troika of Xu Da, Chang Yuchun, and Li Wenzhong were still on the Northern Expedition. Zhu Yuanzhang wrote a letter, ordering Mu Ying to lead an army to protect the queen and the prince to Suzhou.Originally, Ma Taigong was posthumously granted the title of King of Xu, and he was also planning to build a temple and a tomb.Now that Ma Xun has sent back Ma Taigong's remains, Ma Xiuying, a filial daughter, will naturally come.Zhu Yuanzhang was a very filial person. Before he ascended the throne, he had his parents' mausoleums built in his hometown. He had already decided to build the Zhongdu in his hometown Fengyang.Ma Xun was worried and had trouble sleeping and eating, but he couldn't escape now because he was surrounded by people.Ma Xun, who had dark circles under his eyes, came to the yard for a walk after breakfast and said, "Wangcai, have you eaten?" The skinny donkey was very embarrassed, but he ate well.Fine feed, bean cake, and eggs are added. Some good horses do not have such feed.After carefully checking the trough, Ma Xun felt relieved, "Although we brothers are being watched out now, they will not be treated badly. If we are really doomed, at least we will be full to death, right?" The diligent Zhu Yuanzhang also walked out of the room and greeted Ma Xun with a smile, "Brother, are you up so early?" "Walking around." Ma Xun said, "It's a pity that I'm not allowed to go out, so I can only wander around in the courtyard."Zhu Yuanzhang asked with a smile, "Go to Prince Xu's Mansion too?" Ma Xun immediately complained, "It's still in Prince Xu's Mansion. Before I had time to see what Suzhou was like, I was brought here and put under house arrest. That is to say, I was allowed to go to Prince Xu's Mansion every day."Go and burn incense for the old man's coffin." Zhu Yuanzhang said with a smile, "I will accompany you to burn incense for the ancestors.Let's go." Ma Xun was under house arrest at the inn, but the old man's coffin was parked in the temple next to King Xu's mausoleum.Now that Queen Ma has not come to acknowledge her relatives, no one dares to put the old man's coffin into the sacrificial hall, nor dare to ignore the coffin.Ma Xun noticed something was wrong, looked at the guard beside him and asked, "Brother, how big is your official position?" "I used to be a marshal." Zhu Yuanzhang said with a smile, "He is the head of these people, and they are under my control.""Disrespect, disrespect!" Ma Xun immediately felt that this was a big shot, "Brother, can you tell me your name?" Zhu Yuanzhang laughed it off, but he still didn't tell Ma Xun his name.Arriving at the small temple, Ma Xun respectfully offered incense.But when he saw Zhu Yuanzhang also knelt down, kowtowed and offered incense, he suddenly became anxious.After Zhu Yuanzhang finished offering the incense, Ma Xun returned the gift and said, "Brother, isn't it a little uncomfortable for you to do this?"

Zhu Yuanzhang looked at Ma Xun and asked, "What's wrong? You can only offer sacrifices to King Xu, but I can't offer sacrifices?" Ma Xun didn't know how to retort for a while, so he could only say, "I haven't acknowledged it yet. You kowtowed too early." Zhu Yuanzhang smiled and asked, "King Xu didn't leave you a token like a jade pendant? What if?It would be easier if we had a token." Ma Xun was even more depressed, "If I really had a token, I would have taken it out a long time ago.How could I be here without knowing it?" After entering the incense, Zhu Yuanzhang said, "Go out with me and see what's going on in Suzhou." Ma Xun couldn't help it, so he was kept under house arrest.It must be a good thing now that someone can take the initiative to take him out for a walk.Ma Xun asked as he walked, "How old is the eldest brother this year?" "Forty-two, five sons and two daughters." Zhu Yuanzhang glanced at Ma Xun and said, "What else do you want to test me for? Say it quickly." Although Ma Xun was embarrassed, he kept saying, "Brother is so lucky, and his children are so blessed!" The world was initially settled, and the land of Suzhou was also torn by war.Liu Futong and the Yuan army often fought here, and Zhu Yuanzhang continued to restore people's livelihood after taking it.Especially since it has just entered early spring, there are fewer people on the streets now, and most of the people are disheveled and skinny. It is so difficult to eat enough!Ma Xun thought about it for a moment and asked, "Brother, how many days does it take to get here from Yingtian Mansion?" Zhu Yuanzhang calculated and said, "I estimate that the Queen and the others will arrive in five or six days." Ma Xun became anxious and even more uneasy, "Is it really the Queen who came here in person?" Zhu Yuanzhang was amused by Ma Xun's reaction, "It concerns King Xu, since ISince the Queen is here in person, do you think it's reasonable for the Emperor to come?" Ma Xun thought it was reasonable and asked, "If there is any misunderstanding, the Queen would definitely forgive me." Zhu Yuanzhang said with certainty, "That's not necessarily the case.If it is about other things, the Queen's magnanimity may be able to forgive you.Then there can be no mistakes." Then Zhu Yuanzhang joked, "When the Queen comes, you will become King Xu!" Ma Xun was stunned for a moment, and then he realized, "Even if the Queen recognizes me, what does King Xu have to do with me?" Zhu Yuanzhang analyzed it carefully, "Since King Xu only has one daughter and one son,The son of King Xu, the title of King Xu will naturally fall on you."You're kidding!"Ma Xun immediately shook his head, "I have no merit, so I can become King Xu just because I am the younger brother of the queen? How can I be the king if I have a different surname?"Zhu Yuanzhang immediately looked at Ma Xun highly and thought that it was right to call Ma Taigong King Xu.But that was also because Ma Taigong had no heirs, so he was granted the title of King Xu.Guo Zixing has not been posthumously named King of Chuyang yet!Zhu Yuanzhang continued, "Even if you can't be the king, you still have to be the Duke of the country." Ma Xun shook his head and said, "The emperor has not yet named the meritorious officials. There are many people with great achievements in the civil and military affairs of the Manchu Dynasty. Granting me a title will definitely not be justified. Then the title of the Ming Dynasty will be in chaos. Do you think it's okay to grant titles to the families of relatives?"
